mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dodo_show_submission (activity_id, store_id, user_id, nick_name, avatar_url, order_sn, order_snapshot, images, audit_status, note, coupon_id, reward_price, reward_version, request_key, attempts, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{storeId}, #{userId}, #{nickName}, #{avatarUrl}, #{orderSn}, #{orderSnapshot}, #{images}, #{auditStatus}, #{note}, #{couponId}, #{rewardPrice}, #{rewardVersion}, #{requestKey}, #{attempts}, #{version}, #{createMillis}, #{updateMillis})
mapper.update: UPDATE dodo_show_submission SET activity_id = #{activityId}, user_id = #{userId}, nick_name = #{nickName}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, order_sn = #{orderSn}, order_snapshot = #{orderSnapshot}, images = #{images}, audit_status = #{auditStatus}, note = #{note}, coupon_id = #{couponId}, reward_price = #{rewardPrice}, reward_version = #{rewardVersion}, request_key = #{requestKey}, attempts = #{attempts}, version = #{version}, update_time = #{updateMillis} WHERE id = #{id} AND store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, activity_id, store_id, user_id, nick_name, avatar_url, order_sn, order_snapshot, images, audit_status, note, coupon_id, reward_price, reward_version, request_key, attempts, version, create_time, update_time FROM dodo_show_submission WHERE id = #{id} AND store_id = #{storeId} FOR UPDATE
